verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a first-party Teams API, but it is scoped to automating deployment, reporting and audit logs on the Teams plan. Nothing shows it covers the full UI surface, such as sessions, sharing, guest access or host settings. The probes found no public OpenAPI spec or machine-readable API docs. Missing for 10: evidence of API/UI parity, API coverage beyond deployment and audit/reporting, public API reference or OpenAPI spec, availability outside Teams/Enterprise tiers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
